what: Ball Corporation makes aluminium beverage cans. It is one of the largest can makers in the world, supplying beer, soft drink and energy drink companies across the Americas, Europe and Asia.
customers: Brewers, soft drink and energy drink companies, and beverage bottlers worldwide.
money: Beverage Packaging North and Central America
aluminium cans for the US and Mexican markets
cans across Europe, the Middle East and Africa
cans for Brazil and neighbouring markets
moat: Can plants built next to customers' filling lines, because cans are bulky and expensive to ship, which effectively locks in the local supply relationship.
risks: Beverage volumes have been soft as consumers cut back
Debt of about $7.4 billion against little cash
Aluminium costs are volatile, though mostly passed through
It sold its aerospace business, removing a diversifying earnings stream
opportunities: Cans keep taking share from glass and plastic on environmental grounds
Selling the aerospace business funded large buybacks
watch: Can shipment volumes by region and aluminium cost pass-through.
